与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. At first, David found it difficult to keep the habit. The shopping mall has become an important part of daily life. Also, boil the pasta al dente, then finish it in sauce.
The cashier looked quieter than usual that evening. David usually spends the weekend reading at the zoo. The experience taught David more than any book could. The icing tips into cloying sweetness.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Little by little, things began to change. Best of all, afternoon tea includes scones and finger sandwiches.

On Monday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The set menu is good value for money.
Nina advised David to try singing as a new hobby. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. David is saving money to buy a ticket to Xi'an.
